parameters.system_prompt: You are an expert 3D low-poly papercraft designer, origami artist, and 3D unfold engineer. You design foldable low-poly figures made of simple primary geometric volumes where micro-details are illustrated flat on the paper surface. You follow the studio signature aesthetic: cute expressive eyes with circular white catchlights and vibrant paper colors. You generate exactly one image that follows all instructions. Never write any text, letters, watermark or labels. Every rule is mandatory and none may be broken.

prompt_templates.specific_subject:
One reference sheet holding exactly six alternative papercraft designs of the subject: a single canvas in a strict grid of 3 columns and 2 rows (6 equal rectangular cells, 3:2 aspect ratio). Each cell holds one complete 3D low-poly papercraft figure seen in an isometric/axonometric three-quarter perspective from above. The six figures progress row by row, left to right, from the most childlike, cute, and chubby (top-left) to the most mature, elegant, and realistic low-poly form (bottom-right).

Subject: {subject}.

{reference_instruction}

STYLE & GEOMETRY:
- Low-poly papercraft origami sculpture made of clean planar facets with sharp geometric edges.
- Pure flat-shaded polygonal geometry: facets are defined by clean planes and natural directional lighting, with NO black outline strokes, NO drawn ink crease lines, and NO cartoon borders.
- SIGNATURE EYES: Big, cute, expressive round eyes with a prominent circular white catchlight / pupil highlight in the upper-left corner, painted flat onto the head facet, matching the studio signature character aesthetic.
- SIGNATURE PALETTE: Solid, vibrant, authentic papercraft colors matching the training references palette (e.g. golden-yellow with rich chocolate-brown mane for lion cub, vibrant lime-green with soft yellow chest for t-rex, rich orange with cream chest for fox, golden-yellow with brown spots for cheetah).
- FOLDABLE PRIMARY VOLUMES: All bodies, heads, snouts, limbs, and manes consist of simple, solid, closed low-poly volumes (wedges, prisms, polyhedra) suitable for clean 3D reconstruction and papercraft folding.
- SURFACE TEXTURE OVER SCULPTED MICRO-GEOMETRY: Fine details (such as dinosaur or animal teeth, lion mane hair strands, whiskers, claws, eyes, spots, stripes, and mouth lines) are FLAT 2D ILLUSTRATIONS painted directly onto the facet surfaces as a printed texture (UV map style), NEVER protruding 3D physical spikes, jagged cutouts, or thin extrusions.
- SOLID CLOSED SNOUTS: Jaws and muzzles are clean closed geometric blocks; teeth are painted flat along the jawline texture, never modeled as individual 3D cutout spikes.
- Neutral flat light grey #E5E5E5 background across the entire canvas.
- No shadows on the floor, no background gradients, no text, no labels, no cell dividers.

parameters.reference_note_template: VISUAL REFERENCE CONDITIONING ({count} attached image(s)): Faithfully preserve the subject's identity, pose, proportions, colors, markings, and distinctive features shown in the reference photo, but translate them into clean planar low-poly facets WITHOUT black outline strokes, WITHOUT drawn black crease lines, and WITHOUT cartoon borders. All micro-details like teeth, whiskers, and spots must be flat surface illustrations on the facets, not 3D spikes or cutouts. Adopt the signature cute round eyes with white catchlight highlights.

Cell (0,1) [Top-Center]: Playful youthful papercraft figure with soft rounded geometry and cheerful character

Cell (0,2) [Top-Right] (Default Pick #3): Studio signature training style — balanced geometric proportions, expressive signature eyes with white catchlight, exact reference colors and features, translated into clean planar facets without black crease lines
Cell (1,0) [Bottom-Left] (Pick #4): Classic structured papercraft model with elegant faceted planes and precise anatomical structure matching the signature palette
Cell (1,1) [Bottom-Center]: Sophisticated detailed papercraft sculpture with refined angular facets and dynamic posture
Cell (1,2) [Bottom-Right]: Majestic realistic low-poly faceted sculpture with lifelike proportions and dignified mature stance
critical_rules: Strict 3x2 grid of exactly 6 equal cells: exactly 3 columns (left, center, right) and exactly 2 rows (top, bottom). Exactly one figure per cell, totaling exactly 6 figures. Never 4 columns, never 7 or 8 figures.
Isometric/axonometric three-quarter perspective from above in every cell.
Zero text, zero labels, zero words, zero letters anywhere on the canvas.
Every figure is complete, centered in its cell, on flat neutral #E5E5E5 background with no floor shadow.
Zero black stroke outlines: planes are defined by flat shading and geometry, not drawn ink borders or dark seam lines.
Signature eye styling: large cute round eyes with a prominent white circular catchlight reflection painted flat onto the facet.
Flat surface texture details: teeth, claws, whiskers, eyes, spots, and fur textures are painted flat onto the facet surfaces, NEVER modeled as protruding 3D spikes or cutouts.
Simple foldable primary volumes: all snouts, jaws, and limbs are closed solid geometric blocks suitable for papercraft folding.
self_check: Are there exactly 6 cells arranged in a 3x2 grid?
Is every cell drawn in an isometric/axonometric three-quarter view from above?
Is there zero text and zero divider borders anywhere?
Are the figures clean planar low-poly facets without black outline strokes or cartoon ink lines?
Do the figures feature the signature cute eyes with white catchlight reflection?
Are teeth, claws, whiskers, and fine details painted flat onto the facet surfaces rather than separate 3D spikes?
